gems.title: Slavery Memorial
gems.description: Martin Puryear, 2014 · Front Green. A broken cast-iron chain rising from a half-buried dome — links break at eye level and the dome mirrors the sky. A place for quiet reflection: photograph the memorial respectfully, no posing.

gems.title: Advice from a Former Student
gems.description: Nina Katchadourian, 2010 · Faunce House, near reception. Find the abstract ear symbol on the wall — two speakers loop 800 snippets of advice from Brown alumni, classes 1939–2010.

gems.title: Idee di Pietra (Ideas of Stone)
gems.description: Giuseppe Penone, 2006 · Main Green. A 27-ft bronze tree cradling a 5,000-lb granite river stone in its branches. Modeled on a nut tree; shown at dOCUMENTA (13) in 2012.

gems.title: Brown Bear 🐻
gems.description: Eli Harvey, 1922 · Main Green, near Faunce Arch. The 7-ft bronze Bruno on a tall pedestal, funded by a "Put Hair on the Bear" drive that capped student gifts at $1. The pedestal holds slate Roger Williams reportedly stepped on in 1636.

gems.title: Casey Shearer Memorial
gems.description: Howard Ben Tré, 2003 · Casey Shearer '00 Courtyard, Main Green. A fountain of stacked bronze beads and glass — water trickles bead to bead. Honors a beloved Class of 2000 student and sports broadcaster.

gems.title: Reclining Figure No. 2 (Bridge Prop)
gems.description: Henry Moore, 1963 · Main Green. A three-part bronze reclining figure (often climbed on), inspired by London's Waterloo Bridge.

gems.title: Marcus Aurelius
gems.description: 1908 · Ruth Simmons Quad, behind Sayles Hall. A bronze equestrian statue facing Thayer St through Soldiers Memorial Gate — a copy of the original on Capitoline Hill in Rome.

gems.title: War Memorial
gems.description: Richard Fleischner, 1997 · Ruth Simmons Quad, near Soldiers Arch. A bronze lattice with a marble slab of names, roses growing through it. Honors 205 Brown alumni lost in WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
Carla Lavatelli · Science Plaza, in front of the SciLi. A 9-ft abstract sculpture with circular cut-outs on a black granite base. Weighs 7,000+ lbs; unveiled at 1985 Commencement.

gems.title: America One
gems.description: Dušan Džamonja · CIT (Watson Center) entrance, next to the SciLi. Two interlocking silver-and-dark metal discs. By a Croatian sculptor known for circular, WWII-themed works.

gems.title: Infinite Possibility
gems.description: Brown STEAM students, 2019 · Lawn in front of the Engineering Research Center. A polished stainless-steel Möbius-strip sundial — at noon a bead of light traces the sun's yearly path. First student-designed piece approved by Brown's Public Art Committee.

gems.title: Swearer Bear 🐻
gems.description: Nicholas Swearer, 1988 · Maddock Alumni Center garden. A 5'6" standing bronze bear — look inside the mouth: it's actually a person in a bear suit.

gems.title: Little Bear Fountain 🐻
gems.description: 1937 · Next to the Brown Faculty Club, Magee St. A bronze bear perched atop a fountain, slightly off the main campus. A replica of a bear fountain the donor found in Breslau (now Wrocław).

gems.title: Circle Dance
gems.description: Tom Friedman, 2010 · The Walk, Waterman St (across from BERT). Silvery figures dancing in a ring — cast from a maquette of aluminum roasting pans, inspired by Matisse's La Danse.

gems.title: Guardian Birds
gems.description: Façade of Robinson Hall, 64 Waterman St. Carved stone winged creatures on the building's exterior. Robinson Hall (1878) is on the National Register of Historic Places.

gems.title: Pembroke Tribute Garden
gems.description: Steps leading to the Pembroke Campus, by Pembroke Hall. A brick-and-granite monument with a bronze map and plaque. Honors the Women's College (1891) and the 1971 Pembroke–Brown merger.

gems.title: Lines of Sight
gems.description: Diane Samuels, 2006 · Sidney Frank Hall (Meeting St entrance, left then right). Glass bridge walls collaged with 600,000+ cut-glass shapes and engraved quotations — faint hands, enlarged 85x, run the length. Take the spiral staircase for +1 (awarded at review).

gems.title: Posture Mirror
gems.description: Nelson Fitness Center, 1st floor beyond reception. An elegant antique wood-framed full-length mirror from the 1912 women's "correction room"; used until 1971.

gems.title: Indomitable 🐻
gems.description: Nicky Bibby, 2013 · Ittleson Quad, in front of Nelson Fitness Center (Hope St). A towering standing bronze Kodiak (bear ~10 ft, piece ~14 ft) — Brown's most recent mascot bear, cast with the lost-wax process.

gems.title: Infinite Composition
gems.description: Leo Villareal, 2023 · Lindemann Performing Arts Center lobby, 144 Angell St. 58 LED light pillars pulsing with programmed patterns — custom software evokes swirling galaxies, tides, and fireflies.
